upi.notes: No UPI freeze/deregister path is published: the bank's unauthorized-transactions page lists block mechanisms for 'Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking and Mobile Banking' only. In the INDIE mobile banking app, UPI is managed under the home-page 'Manage UPI' hub — dispute a UPI transaction via 'Manage UPI' > 'My UPI Transactions' > 'View All' > select the transaction > 'Raise Dispute'; collect requests can be 'Pay, Decline or Mark as SPAM' under 'Manage UPI' > 'My Payment Requests'. To report an unauthorized transaction the page says 'To report an unauthorized transaction(s): Click Here', opening the bank's Online Dispute Resolution portal (https://www.indusind.bank.in/in/en/microsites/forms/online-dispute-resolution.html — mobile + DOB OTP login, complaint type 'Fraudulent Transaction', fields include 'UPI VPA (Virtual Payment Address)'); it also says 'Call Helpline Number 1930' or report at cybercrime.gov.in. Phone Banking 1860 267 7777 (site-wide header incl. the bank's UPI page https://www.indusind.bank.in/in/en/personal/payment-solutions/upi.html; the unauthorized-transaction call line names 'Debit Card / Net Banking / Mobile Banking', not UPI). The bank's USSD page (https://www.indusind.bank.in/in/en/personal/mobile-banking-services/indus-mobile-ussd.html) publishes UPI over *99# — 'Simply dial *99#' or *99*69# (quick codes e.g. *99*1# fund transfer), services include 'UPI ID management' and 'Set UPI PIN' — a transaction channel, not a freeze channel. androidApp is the 'Download Now' link on the bank's BHIM IndusPay microsite (Android only; INDIE app store links are published only as QR codes and no iOS store URL is published for IndusPay). The bank's UPI page links NPCI's 'My UPI' self-service ('Explore Now' → https://www.upihelp.npci.org.in/) to view/manage linked bank accounts, UPI IDs, UPI-enabled apps and active mandates. No netbanking UPI manage/disable path is published on official pages.
